revise.title: Explore a tour on the map
revise.lead: Guests compare tours, follow the itinerary on a 3D map of Lucerne, and see which departure dates still have seats before they choose one.
callouts: 3D route map
Tapping a numbered stop opens a card with what the guide shows there, so guests see the route before booking.
Tours at a glance
Each card shows the duration, the lowest price and the next departure date, or says Sold out or Coming soon.
Seats left per date
Every departure date lists how many seats remain, and a sold-out date is greyed out and cannot be selected.

revise.title: Book a tour, hold seats for 15 minutes
revise.lead: The guest confirms contact details and pays the amount due today, and the seats stay held for 15 minutes while the payment is completed.
callouts: 15-minute seat hold
The clock starts when the guest continues to payment, keeps running after a reload and is not restarted by a failed attempt.
Payment rule per departure
Each date is set to full payment, a 30% deposit with the balance later, or booking now and paying later.
Booked is not paid
The confirmation shows booking status and payment status separately, with the amount still owed and its due date.

new.title: Know what is included before booking
new.lead: The tour page tells guests what is and is not included, what each age group pays, and the payment and cancellation rules, before they choose a date.
phones: Tours without open seats or dates stay visible but cannot be booked.
Inclusions, exclusions and the price for each age group.
Meeting point, conditions, payment terms, cancellation.
callouts: Inclusions and exclusions
Lists what the price covers, such as a local guide, and what it does not, such as food, drinks and transport.
Prices by age group
Adults (16+) pay CHF 89, children (6–15) CHF 45, and infants (0–5) are free and take no seat.
Policies in plain words
Meeting point, participation conditions, payment terms per date and cancellation rules open as short sections below the prices.

new.title: Choose a date and your group
new.lead: A bottom sheet lists every departure with its seats left and payment rule, then guests set how many adults, children and infants join.
phones: Seats left and payment rule for each date.
Counters stop at the seats left.
Another guest booked first, so the group no longer fits.
callouts: Seats left per departure
Each date shows its seats left, and fully booked dates show Sold out and cannot be selected.
Who needs a seat
Adults and children each use one seat, infants use none, and at least one adult must join the group.
Checked again at booking
Choosing a date reserves nothing; if another guest takes the seats first, the sheet warns that the group no longer fits.

new.title: Review the booking, sign in on the way
new.lead: Guests check the price, their contact details and the amount due today before signing in, and nothing they typed is lost afterwards.
phones: Contact name and mobile are required; a child's name is optional.
Google or an emailed code, no password.
Due now, remaining balance and cancellation policy.
callouts: Sign in only at the end
Guests see the full review first; signing in with Google or an emailed code returns them to the same booking.
Amount due today
The review separates the booking total, what is paid now (a 30% deposit here, CHF 66.90) and the remaining balance.
Deadline and policy up front
The balance due date (here Thu 15 Oct, 18:00) and the cancellation policy are shown before any payment.

new.title: Failed payment and expired holds
new.lead: A declined payment can be retried until the 15 minutes run out; after that the seats go back on sale and the guest rebooks.
phones: No money taken; the same countdown keeps running.
Seats released; a button checks availability again.
Expired bookings stay listed as No payment taken.
callouts: Retry in the same window
A declined payment takes no money and the guest may try again, but the original deadline keeps running.
Expiry releases the seats
When the hold ends the booking becomes Expired, its seats are released once, and the payment can no longer be made.
Rebook from the same page
Check availability again reopens the departure sheet with the group kept, and seats and prices are re-checked.

new.title: Confirmation depends on how the guest paid
new.lead: Every confirmed booking shows what was paid and what is still due, then offers a calendar file and an optional short trip profile.
phones: Nothing charged; full amount due by the deadline.
No balance, nothing further to pay.
Add the date; three optional questions.

new.title: Pay the balance later, without a new hold
new.lead: From the account, a guest opens the booking, pays the remaining balance online, and keeps a record of payments, progress and the agreed terms.
phones: No countdown: seats are already confirmed.
Each payment with its amount and date.
Timeline: booking created, each payment received.
Payment and cancellation terms, organiser contact.

new.title: After the tour: delivered, no-show, reviews
new.lead: The shop records what happened on the day, the guest's booking reflects it, and only a completed booking can be reviewed.
phones: Tour done; the unpaid balance can still be paid.
Payments stay visible; no completion or review.
Paid in full; Write a review appears.
Rating and comment, shown on the tour page.
